verses.1: Livnei Amnon said, “Yahweh said: ‘There is no one in Israel who can inherit the throne. He has no knowledge of how to inherit his king’s kingdom and rule over his people in their cities.’”
verses.2: So now, behold, days come when the LORD will speak. I heard the cries of the people of Israel for war. Their children will be destroyed by fire. And Israel will inherit their possessions. The LORD said:
verses.3: They thought that their queen was crying out in pain. Her daughters were also in pain, and they were trembling in fear. Their king was in danger; his priests and ministers were together with him.
verses.4: How can I praise you in your depths? You are so profound and mysterious. The beautiful woman who comes with her treasures… Who can approach me?
verses.5: I bring upon you fear, O Lord Jehovah! Your armies from all around you will be rejected by everyone before you. There will be no one who can save you from this situation.
verses.6: And after that, I will restore the inheritance of the descendants of Jacob, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.7: Edom said, “As for you, O gods! There is no more wisdom in this age. The plans of men have been ruined; their wisdom has been destroyed.”
verses.8: Nusu turned to them and said, “Deepen your understanding of those who dwell in Dadan. For I have brought them upon me during my inspection.”
verses.9: If robbers come to you, they will not leave any remains behind. If thieves attack at night, they will destroy everything in their path.
verses.10: For I have revealed his deeds, and I have uncovered their secrets. Now he cannot hide from his own descendants, his brothers, his neighbors, or anyone else.
verses.11: I will leave your wives behind; I will take care of you and your children. You can trust me.
verses.12: For thus said Jehovah: “See, their judgment is not to be obeyed. They will be punished, but you will be forgiven. You will not be punished, because you have committed adultery.”
verses.13: For in me I will be honored, says the LORD. But for them, there will be shame, destruction, and punishment. Their cities will become ruins forever.
verses.14: I have heard from Jehovah that the messengers in the nations will come and stand before her, and they will go forth to fight.
verses.15: For behold, you were given a small portion of land in those nations, but it was still limited to just one person.
verses.16: Your sin has brought shame upon you. It has made me miserable during the days of celebration. I will be freed from its torment, just as those who are raised from the dead will be freed from their sins. May Jehovah help you!
verses.17: And it shall be like Adam, who will carry all the burdens upon itself and work all the hard labor.
verses.18: In a miraculous way, Sdom, Amorah, and their neighbors said, “The LORD says that no man shall sit there, nor shall any human being live there.”
verses.19: Look, like a lion that rises from the heights of the Jordan River to reach Nueah Eitan. It’s as if we are being brought up from above it. Who can stand against me? Who can testify against me? And who is worthy to stand before me?
verses.20: Therefore, listen to the advice of Jehovah. He advised Adam and his thoughts regarding the inhabitants of Tiamat. If they are not to be burdened by the young animals, then they must not be placed upon them.
verses.21: From the depths of the valley, a noise arose. The earth cried out in despair. In the sea of silence, that sound was no longer heard.
verses.22: Look! The serpent will rise up, spread its wings over the land, and become like a cat that has been trapped. On that day, it will become the heart of the kings of men.
verses.23: Ledesmek Bošah Hamat and Arpad: They heard bad news. They were very worried in the sea. The calmness couldn’t be maintained anymore.
verses.24: She ripped off her clothes, turned towards us, and grabbed them tightly. She held them like a newborn baby.
verses.25: How could a city be abandoned when its inhabitants are still alive?
verses.26: Therefore, they will fall in their own places, in their own ruins. And all those who are involved in battle will be destroyed on that day. May the Lord’s army say: “May they be destroyed!”
verses.27: And I lit a fire in the house of Damashq, and ate the armenot, son of Hadad.
verses.28: To Kedar and to the royal women who were under the rule of Nebukadnezar, king of Babylon. Thus said Jehovah: “Come forth and attack Kedar! Destroy the sons of Kedar!”
verses.29: Their tents and their possessions they will take with them. They will carry all their belongings and their clothes. They will also call upon a “Magoor” from around them.
verses.30: They became very wise and deep in their understanding. They knew the ways of the people who lived by the borderlands. They obeyed the commands of Jehovah. They received advice from King Babylon, and he gave them wise counsel.
verses.31: Come, let us go to his land. There, he will dwell in peace. The Lord will not let his gates be closed, nor will there be any danger for him alone.
verses.32: And let their livestock be used as food, and let their goods be used for trade. Let they be a source of wealth for every soul. From all their possessions, I will bring them back, says the LORD.
verses.33: And it will become a place where no man shall ever live or dwell there.
verses.34: It was the word of Jehovah to Jeremiah, the prophet, regarding Eilam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah, king of Judah. It was said:
verses.35: Thus said Jehovah, the God of hosts: “I will break the pride of their heads, from the beginning of their greatness.”
verses.36: And I brought four winds from the four corners of the heavens. These winds were assigned to each of these four groups of winds. And those who do not come there will be rejected by Eilam.
verses.37: And I have humbled them before their enemies and before those who seek to harm them. I have brought upon them the punishment of Jehovah. And I have sent destruction upon them to their very depths.
verses.38: And I placed my throne there, and from there I was overthrown by kings and princes. May the LORD have mercy on me!
verses.39: And in those days, I will restore the throne of Eilam, says Jehovah.
